epic.intent:
## Outcome
Notify the person whenever a hosted agent or Dark Mechanicus workflow requires human interaction, without watching every terminal. Notifications belong to the completed hybrid GUI/TUI workspace: an actionable global inbox and folder/chat badges inside the app, plus OS notifications when the relevant source is not focused. Clicking reveals the exact question, approval, sign-in, pause, checkpoint/retry or card-review source; it never answers or changes authority.

## Confirmed decisions (2026-11-15)
- New, separate FOLLOW-UP to Hybrid chat workspace (ep_01m6q23ddmdxpzw7pqgyc5hyb7), not extra work added to its active run. Initial providers: Skitarii/OMP, Claude Code, Codex. Cursor, Autonomous and custom CLI notification adapters are deferred.
- Include explicit questions awaiting a response, actual permission/tool-approval waits, confirmed sign-in needs, explicit agent/run pauses and human checkpoint/retry/card-review decisions. Exclude ordinary completed responses, idle/silent output, tool execution, dependency waits, observer-reader pauses and automatic checkpoint continuation.
- In-app inbox and badges always retain outstanding attention, including background chats and collapsed folders. OS notification is considered once for a new wait if its relevant destination is not focused; focused destination gets in-app attention only. No repeated timer nagging, sound, remote push or background service.
- User chose bounded REDACTED PREVIEWS in OS notifications. Preview is plain text, control/ANSI/bidi-safe and masked before any persistence or OS delivery; never raw commands/tool arguments, credentials, environment dumps or arbitrary file paths. Safe generic reason is used when redaction or source content is unavailable; this is not a claim that a preview is safe to expose on every lock screen. Provide a generic-only privacy option and OS on/off setting, machine-local.
- Windows is required, including packaged native notification proof. Keep implementation portable; macOS native delivery/click/packaging proof is explicitly deferred, not a completion claim.

## Hard launch prerequisite and dependency limits
DO NOT start this epic's run or claim its tickets before Hybrid is status completed after its FINAL human checkpoint and its required Windows increment is integrated. Completion of a ticket or interim checkpoint is insufficient. At launch inspect get_epic/get_checkpoint and pin Hybrid's closing revision and integrated commit in the first ticket evidence. Revalidate all source seams against that closed increment. There is no supported cross-epic dependency edge: this prerequisite is an explicit orchestrator launch rule, sprint entry criterion and reciprocal tracking comment, NOT a server-enforced scheduler or automatic launch. Leave this epic Backlog; do not start or modify Hybrid from this planning session. Create the feature branch from the closed integrated base at execution, never the currently unfinished source.

## User journeys and lifecycle
1. An agent asks a structured human question or permission request. A request-identity-scoped pending item and badge appear, even for a collapsed folder. A background OS alert contains its safe preview. Selecting it reveals the original live CLI prompt without submitting text, Enter, approval or resume.
2. Human-gated checkpoint, exhausted-ticket retry, ready-for-review card or explicit run pause appears from authoritative domain state, with the exact report/card/run destination. A blocked report must not be presented as approval-ready. Auto-authorized continuation is not a human wait.
3. Reading or dismissing a notification changes only acknowledgement; the wait stays pending until an authoritative answer/resume/cancel/removal/lifecycle transition resolves or invalidates it. A separate new request gets a new alert. Historical replay, reload and overlapping readers do not duplicate alerts.
4. Renderer reload/app restart reconstructs currently valid workflow waits without replaying historical toasts. Provider-generation items whose live binding no longer exists become stale/history, not falsely pending or resolved. Untracking a folder or deleting a source retires its items and rejects stale clicks. An unavailable source is marked unavailable, not silently complete.
5. OS support/permission failure or Do Not Disturb never removes the in-app item. Desktop must be running (minimized is supported); fully quit/headless-only event delivery and click-to-launch are out of scope. On reopening, reconcile current waits rather than alerting for every historical event.

## Architecture and evidence
Use a main-owned, bounded attention service, typed provider/request identity and app-local persistence in userData/app.sqlite. Reuse canonical folder/chat/run/card IDs and terminal physical-generation fencing; semantic attention is separate from observational ActivitySnapshot. A narrow authenticated per-launch provider ingress is required for actual question/approval open/resolve events. Reuse or extend verified local control infrastructure only where it preserves capability separation; never expose notification publishing through web content, accept a folder/chat asserted by a payload, or grant agents desktop/human controls. No raw PTY scraping, silence timeout, question-mark detection, newest-global-transcript guessing or SDK/app-server replacement of the real CLI.
Current terminal ports carry output/exit, existing OMP extension carries work lifecycle, Claude settings compose memory-protection hooks and Codex fresh sessions lack proven live semantic binding. Therefore Sprint 1 is a bounded version-pinned feasibility/contract investigation, not a promise that provider APIs exist. It must prove opening AND resolution for required triggers, preserving CLI operation and approval policy. If a provider cannot satisfy the contract with sanctioned terminal-compatible interfaces, the checkpoint remains blocked pending a specific human scope/design decision; do not fake parity, silently drop a provider, vendor-patch or replace its runtime.

## Scope/non-goals and safety
Human-directed local notifications only. Peer-to-peer Skitarii messages remain in their separate communications epic; that epic is not a prerequisite here. No new messaging transport, autonomous prompt answers, click-to-approve buttons, permission bypass, global vendor-config mutation, terminal restarts for navigation, always-on-top/foreground stealing on arrival, or background daemon. Existing terminal image/browser/Activity behavior, memory guard, sign-in boundaries and human-only checkpoint/retry/card controls remain intact. Child-agent reports alone are not human waits; propagate only a verified request to the owning human-facing chat and deduplicate it.

## Verification and standards
Each worker writes and runs the consumer-visible tests listed in its Tests section and targeted lint/typecheck when code changes; no plan-wide tests-first requirement or extra Fireguard grading requirement is added. At each sprint acceptance run the project's six Definition of Done checks once on the combined increment. Final Windows evidence must include actual owned OMP/Claude/Codex human-wait/resolution demonstrations, exact versions, real packaged native alert/click and focused/minimized/background-chat cases, accessible inbox/browser occlusion, zero terminal-input/permission mutations from navigation, stale-generation/restart/dedup and privacy negatives. Synthetic fixtures prove logic but not vendor/native behavior. Isolate app/vendor configuration; inspect unexpected onboarding before any input and stop safely. Human-only controls in real product are exercised by a person, never by agent automation. No implementation or commits are authorized by this planning request alone. Document support, OS limits, privacy and deferred macOS proof.

successCriteria.text: Execution begins only after Hybrid chat workspace closes through its final human checkpoint, from its integrated increment; the source closure and commit are recorded.

On verified OMP, Claude Code and Codex cohorts, actual human questions, permission waits, sign-in needs and explicit pauses produce correctly scoped items with truthful resolution; unsupported cases block completion rather than infer from idle output.

Human checkpoint/retry/card-review and run-pause conditions appear from authoritative state for all tracked folders, including collapsed ones, without treating automatic continuation or ordinary completion as human attention.

An accessible inbox and folder/chat badges reveal the exact original hybrid terminal or decision surface; clicking cannot send input, restart a CLI, approve, grant retry, review a card or resume anything.

Unfocused destinations receive one bounded redacted-preview Windows OS alert per new wait; focused destinations, replay, dismissals and renderer reloads do not cause duplicate alerts; failure preserves the in-app item.
Pending, seen, dismissed, resolved, stale and delivery status remain distinct across restart, removal and generation replacement, with bounded machine-local storage and no raw secret retention.
Real provider and packaged Windows notification/click evidence, privacy/security/focus regressions, docs and six project DoD checks pass; macOS native proof remains explicitly deferred.

bundle.rationale:
## Evidence and decisions
Inspected README/process boundaries, collaboration/planner/graph guides, shared command/bundle schemas, appDatabase, Claude settings and OMP extension; read-only provider and UI investigators mapped launch/auth/activity, shell/landing/occlusion, domain gate/retry/card state and existing tests. Current terminal ports are byte/process transports, not semantic attention. Existing ActivitySnapshot is observation, not a human-wait authority; legacy approval transcript types are not current provider seams. Current shell feed omits collapsed folders. Dependency graph resolves tickets only within one epic.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs
Selected main-owned state plus narrow version-proven provider events: preserves background coverage, exact source binding and native delivery at the cost of explicit adapter feasibility. Rejected PTY text/question-mark/silence heuristics: false waits, missed prompts and spoofable content. Rejected treating agent_end/task_complete/turn_aborted as a wait: ordinary response completion is explicitly excluded. Rejected SDK/app-server replatforming and vendor patches: not authorized, changes real CLI/approval contract. Rejected renderer-only subscriptions/localStorage: miss background folders and cannot own durable OS dedup. Rejected remote push/background daemon and cross-epic scheduler additions: not requested. Selected user-requested redacted previews with generic-only option; redaction reduces known sensitive-pattern leakage but cannot prove arbitrary natural language non-sensitive. Warn about OS/lock-screen visibility, omit raw tool/environment/path bodies and fall back generic for unsafe/unavailable preview.

## Sequencing and ownership
External launch prerequisite: Hybrid ep_01m6q23ddmdxpzw7pqgyc5hyb7 must be completed after final human checkpoint and integrated before start_run; provenance/comments/entry criteria communicate this but do not enforce it server-side. Sprint 1: one bounded provider/identity/preview/focus contract investigation; acceptance independently verifies real evidence and six DoD, then human decides whether the evidence supports implementation. Unsupported required provider/trigger is a blocker and requires a saved replan, not silent scope reduction. Sprint 2: store/shared contract first; ingress, workflow collector and UI can then run in parallel. OMP/Claude/Codex require ingress; OS delivery requires UI focus/click contract. Native witness joins providers + workflow + OS, documentation consumes its accepted support evidence, then sprint acceptance verifies the integrated result. No manual dependency edges into acceptance nodes. Critical chain: feasibility -> store -> ingress -> provider -> native -> docs -> final acceptance, or store -> UI -> OS -> native if UI delivery dominates.
Providers should own their adapter modules/fixtures; ingress owns launch injection and bootstrap service composition; UI owns shared desktop/preload/landing changes. For changes to an already owned file, orchestrator integrates a single prepared patch or sequences shared hunks, not competing branches editing the same bridge. Row checks follow accepted combined outputs. No integration-only ticket is needed.

## Risks and mitigations
Provider API gaps/version drift: exact official schemas and actual owned request/resolution evidence first; refusal on unsupported versions. Fresh/resumed identity and old-generation callbacks: opaque physical launch binding, request IDs and explicit invalidation. Secrets: pre-persistence sanitizer, strict field projection/size limits, fixture leak tests, configurable generic mode and visible privacy caveat. Native browser/window focus and accidental CLI restart: main-validated focus ownership, existing occlusion leases, inspection-only landings and zero-input witness. Historical replay/toast floods: main local transactions/cursors and separate pending/seen/delivery states, authoritative startup reconciliation, no historical toast replay. OS exactly-once is not generally transactional: at-most-once attempt receipts, explicit unknown/failure status, in-app source of truth. Collapsed folders/headless changes: main-owned global tracked-folder collector, bounded event cursors/current-state reads, avoid getRun lease-expiry polling mutation. Resource growth: numeric frame/queue/history/preview limits frozen in Sprint 1, resolved-first pruning, explicit pressure handling never silent pending loss. Human controls: notification is navigation only; protected decisions remain person-owned.

## Acceptance and verification
Each work ticket specifies its targeted tests and artifacts; source locations are verified current entry points or explicitly proposed new files to rebase against closed Hybrid. Default project DoD only, no extra tests-first/Fireguard mandate. Each acceptance node runs the six get_project Definition of Done checks once on its combined increment. Its covers criteria name every required work ticket. Final owned provider + actual packaged Windows OS/click/preview/focus/restart/occlusion evidence is required with genuine attached screenshots, exact builds and zero terminal/domain mutation receipts. Windows-native gaps stay unmet, no synthetic substitute. macOS native acceptance, other providers, external unhosted sessions, peer messaging and app-fully-quit alerts are explicit non-goals. Two human checkpoints remain; nothing auto-starts when Hybrid completes.
